notablePrerequisites: You control three or more artifacts including an Equipment.
description:
Cast Priest of Urabrask by paying its mana cost.
When Priest of Urabrask enters, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate an Equipment's equip ability given to it by Puresteel Paladin by paying {0}, targeting Priest of Urabrask.
Cowardice triggers, returning Priest of Urabrask from the battlefield to your hand.
The ability from step 3 fizzles due to having no valid target.
Repeat.
